SELECT id, name, description, sort, create_time, update_time FROM tb_category
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description, c.sort ORDER BY c.sort ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM tb_category c LEFT JOIN tb_article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1 WHERE c.id = #{id} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.description
